messages:
jordan: CI went red on my PR (D-4567). mypy failed on the ubuntu typecheck job but everything passes locally for me. log snippet below — anyone seen this flake before?

ci-bot: Job <typecheck-ubuntu-22.04> failed (exit code 1). Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/23456

mei: can you paste the exact mypy error line? sometimes stub/stdlib versions differ across runners.

jordan: sure — here's the relevant excerpt from the build log:
```
src/kvcache/cache.py:78: error: Item "None" of "Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]" has no attribute "get"
  78 | value = config.get("cache_ttl", 3600)
```

jordan: locally `mypy src/kvcache` is clean. the failing runner is `ubuntu-22.04-x64` (typecheck worker). PR is just a small refactor+rebase onto main.

priya: that looks like an intermittent incremental cache hit — if the runner reuses a cached .mypy_cache from a different python version it can produce spurious errors. can you try a CI rerun with a clean cache? (/rerun-job cleans cache on that worker)

blake: i'll kick the rerun now — giving it a nudge.

ci-bot: Rerun started for job <typecheck-ubuntu-22.04> (triggered by blake).

ci-bot: Rerun completed: job passed.

jordan: ok it passed on rerun. thanks! seems flaky. i'll still push a defensive fix (explicit None check) to avoid the false positive and add a tiny unit test.

mei: sounds good. maybe add `# type: ignore[union-attr]` only if you can't refactor; otherwise a runtime None-check is nicer. also note: ensure the CI uses `--cache-dir=...` per job so caches don't cross-run.

priya: unrelated note — saw a separate pre-commit rustfmt failure on a different branch earlier today; just flagging that infra might be noisy this morning.

jordan: will open a follow-up PR with the guard and a changelog entry. thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

blake: no worries — if this keeps popping up we can add a CI step to clear mypy cache between runs.

jordan: agreed. marking this one resolved for now.
